title: How a Godly Man Waits for a Wife Without Getting Desperate
caption:
You know the guy. Checking her story before his alarm even goes off. Showing up to things because she might be there. Rehearsing a text like it's a job.

That's not romance. That's a man asking a woman to fill what only God was built to fill.

A godly man doesn't stop wanting a wife. He stops needing one to feel like a man. He gives God the hours he used to give her: the Word before the group chat, the prayer before the plan.

If she's not choosing you, walking away isn't losing. It's obedience.

"But seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be added to you." (Matthew 6:33)

A wife was never the goal. She's what happens to a man while he's busy becoming godly.

Save this for the next time you catch yourself chasing instead of building.

theme: He chases God, not a wife.
